style.look: photorealistic, cinematic UGC ad, shot on a full-frame cinema camera, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, natural skin texture with visible pores and light sweat
style.color_grade: warm tungsten highlights on walls, deep blacks, slightly desaturated teal-grey shadows, high contrast; phone screen glows saturated neon green
style.lighting: practical overhead strip lights and warm wall wash, soft key from above-front, gentle rim light on hair and shoulders
style.camera_feel: handheld-stabilised gimbal, subtle natural micro-movement, no shaky cam
style.pacing: five hard cuts, no transitions, no on-screen captions, no subtitles, no logos or watermarks

character.description: White man in his late 20s, heavy-set and overweight with a rounded belly, short dark-brown hair styled forward with a slight messy fringe, short full beard, ruddy cheeks, brown eyes
character.wardrobe: plain fitted black crew-neck t-shirt, charcoal grey athletic shorts above the knee, white crew socks, white trainers, black square smartwatch on left wrist
character.props: black gym duffel bag worn on a shoulder strap across his back, clear plastic shaker bottle with black flip lid filled halfway with a pink-red drink, black lifting straps with red accents in his other hand, black smartphone
character.voice: male, British accent, natural conversational tone
character.consistency: identical face, hair, beard, body and outfit in every shot

environment.details: exposed black steel ceiling beams and ductwork, rows of fluorescent strip lights, warm-lit beige back walls, dark speckled rubber floor, black squat racks, cable machines, benches and dumbbells, a few blurred gym-goers training in the background, glass entrance door with black frame
environment.ambient_audio: busy gym atmosphere: clanking plates, distant chatter, muffled background music, footsteps on rubber flooring

shots.framing: medium-wide, rear view from behind at waist height
shots.camera: follow shot tracking behind him as he pushes through the glass gym door and walks forward into the gym; camera keeps steady distance, slight push forward
shots.action: He pushes the black-framed glass door open with his right hand and strides confidently into the gym, duffel bag bouncing at his hip, arms swinging; gym-goers at the benches glance up at him

dialogue.speaker: gym_newbie
dialogue.delivery: upbeat, pumped, self-motivating, said slightly louder as he walks in

shots.audio: door swing, footsteps, gym ambience rising

shots.framing: starts as a full-body front shot, ends as an extreme close-up of his face (eyes, nose and mouth filling frame)
shots.camera: slow continuous dolly push-in from full body to extreme close-up over the whole shot
shots.action: He stands still in the middle of the gym floor holding the shaker bottle at chest height and the lifting straps at his side, glancing left and right at the equipment; his confidence drains, his brow furrows, sweat beads on his forehead, he looks lost and overwhelmed; at the end he squints and frowns in confusion

dialogue.speaker: gym_newbie
dialogue.delivery: quiet, bewildered, half to himself, eyebrows pinched, mouth slightly open

shots.audio: gym ambience: heavy plate clank, chatter; ambience stays loud before the line

shots.framing: medium shot, chest-up, slightly low angle
shots.action: Standing by a dark grey wall with a fluorescent strip light and a small notice on the wall, bag strap over his shoulder, he looks down and types on his phone with both thumbs, focused

dialogue.speaker: gym_newbie
dialogue.delivery: muttered as he types it, like reading his search out loud

shots.framing: POV insert close-up of his left hand holding the smartphone vertically, screen fills most of the frame
shots.camera: static POV with slight hand movement, background a soft dark grey blur
shots.action: His right index finger scrolls down a dark-themed trainer leaderboard web app; cards flick past with slight motion blur, then the list settles on the 'Top Trainers — UK' section with a green 'LIVE' pill. All cards are dark and unlit at this point. His index finger then deliberately presses down on Tracy Gibson's #01 card. The instant his fingertip touches the card, and only then, the card lights up: a bright neon-green glow blooms outward from the exact point of the fingertip and spreads to fill the card's border and halo. His finger stays pressed on the card for a moment while the glow builds, then lifts away and the card stays glowing. Each card shows a rank number, round trainer profile photo, name with green verified tick, a small 'FOUNDER' badge, location pin, a 'Weight Loss' tag, an 'ONLINE & IN PERSON' tag, verified review count, and a large neon-green score with a dumbbell icon on the right

beats.beat: Finger scrolls the list; no card is glowing
Fingertip taps and presses onto Tracy Gibson's #01 card; the card is still unlit at the moment of contact
Finger held on the card; green glow ripples out from under the fingertip and grows to a full bright halo around the card
Finger lifts off and moves out of frame; Tracy Gibson's card stays fully glowing green, the other cards stay dark

shots.cause_and_effect: The glow is a direct response to his touch: no glow before the tap, glow starts at the fingertip on contact, never appears on its own after the finger has left

screen_content.app_header: white bar with green circular 'CC' logo and the wordmark 'CoachCards', hamburger menu on the right, status bar time 6:55
screen_content.palette: near-black cards, neon green (#3CFF6B-ish) accents and glow, white serif names

shots.audio: no speech; soft UI scroll swish, then a crisp tap sound and gentle chime exactly as the fingertip presses Tracy Gibson's card and the glow blooms

shots.framing: medium close-up, chest-up, three-quarter angle, warm gym background softly blurred
shots.action: He looks down at the phone in his hands (shaker bottle tucked in the same hand) and breaks into a relieved smile, then lifts his head and looks up and off to the right, eyebrows raised, hopeful and reassured
shots.audio: gym ambience softens under the line

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, on-screen text overlays, watermark, extra logos, brand-name clothing, distorted hands, extra fingers, warped phone screen, garbled or misspelled app text, face changing between shots, different outfit, cartoon, CGI look, oversaturated skin, shaky camera, slow motion, crossfade transitions, background music drowning out dialogue, card glowing before it is tapped, glow appearing after the finger has moved away, glow appearing on its own without a touch, every card glowing at once
